lines.text: Is a tan a shield? A thin one, built after the harm.
lines.phonemes: ɪz ɐ tˈan ɐ ʃˈiːld? ɐ θˈɪn wˌɒn, bˈɪlt ˈaftə ðə hˈɑːm.

lines.text: Sunlight carries ultraviolet, and its shorter rays reach the living cells under the dead layer. In under a trillionth of a second, one can fuse two letters of their DNA.
lines.phonemes: sˈʌnlaɪt kˈaɹiz ˌʊltɹɐvˈaɪəlɪt, and ɪts ʃˈɔːtə ɹˈeɪz ɹˈiːtʃ ðə lˈɪvɪŋ sˈɛlz ˌʌndə ðə dˈɛd lˈeɪə. ɪn ˌʌndəɹ ɐ tɹˈɪliənθ əvə sˈɛkənd, wˈɒn kan fjˈuːz tˈuː lˈɛtəz ɒv ðeə dˌiːˌɛnˈeɪ.

lines.text: The cell notices. A guardian protein switches on, and the cell sends a chemical message down to the pigment cells: make melanin.
lines.phonemes: ðə sˈɛl nˈəʊtɪsɪz. ɐ ɡˈɑːdiən pɹˈəʊtiːn swˈɪtʃɪz ˈɒn, and ðə sˈɛl sˈɛndz ɐ kˈɛmɪkəl mˈɛsɪdʒ dˌaʊn tə ðə pˈɪɡmənt sˈɛlz: mˈeɪk mˈɛlənɪn .

lines.text: In Boston, mice whose skin cells lacked that guardian never tanned at all. So a tan isn't skin getting ready for the sun. It's skin answering damage already done.
lines.phonemes: ɪn bˈɒstən, mˈaɪs hˌuːz skˈɪn sˈɛlz lˈakt ðat ɡˈɑːdiən nˈɛvə tˈand at ˈɔːl. sˌəʊ ɐ tˈan ˌɪzənt skˈɪn ɡˌɛtɪŋ ɹˈɛdi fəðə sˈʌn. ɪts skˈɪn ˈansəɹɪŋ dˈamɪdʒ ɔːlɹˌɛdi dˈʌn.

lines.text: Over the next few days, the melanin settles over each nucleus like a tiny parasol. Together, a whole tan adds up to about SPF three or four.
lines.phonemes: ˌəʊvə ðə nˈɛkst fjˈuː dˈeɪz, ðə mˈɛlənɪn sˈɛtəlz ˌəʊvəɹ ˈiːtʃ njˈuːklɪəs lˈaɪk ɐ tˈaɪni pˈæɹəsɒl . təɡˈɛðə, ɐ hˈəʊl tˈan ˈadz ˌʌp tʊ ɐbˌaʊt ˌɛspˌiːˈɛf θɹˈiː ɔː fˈɔː.

lines.text: Each parasol is about as wide as its nucleus: a dozen stacked would be as thick as a sheet of paper.
lines.phonemes: ˈiːtʃ pˈæɹəsɒl ɪz ɐbˌaʊt az wˈaɪd az ɪts njˈuːklɪəs: ɐ dˈʌzən stˈakt wʊd biː az θˈɪk az ɐ ʃˈiːt ɒv pˈeɪpə.

lines.text: So, is a tan a shield? A thin one. It's how your skin remembers the light.
lines.phonemes: sˈəʊ, ɪz ɐ tˈan ɐ ʃˈiːld? ɐ θˈɪn wˌɒn. ɪts hˌaʊ jɔː skˈɪn ɹɪmˈɛmbəz ðə lˈaɪt.

lines.text: Next: who has more pigment cells, the darkest skin or the lightest?
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: hˌuː hɐz mˈɔː pˈɪɡmənt sˈɛlz, ðə dˈɑːkɪst skˈɪn ɔː ðə lˈaɪtɪst?
